newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Russia's Novosibirsk 1996 tin output 12,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Novosibirsk 1996 tin output 12,000 tonnes.

text.p: Novosibirsk Integrated Tin Works, Russia's biggest producer of tin and tin products, produced 12,000 tonnes of tin metal in 1996, Vladimir Bogdanov, the company's chief expert on foreign relations, said.
The disclosure was made at the first World Tin Conference organised by the International Tin Research Institute.
Novosibirsk normally releases figures as a percentage of 1991 production. In 1997, output is expected to amount to 80 percent of the 1991 level, up from 77 percent in 1996.
Bogdannov declined to give sales figures but said that 40 percent of Russian consumption was for tinplate and another 25 percent for solders.
Russian tin metal exports in 1997 totalled 40 percent of the 1995 level, down from 88 percent in 1996, he added.
